summary.headline: Stellar Mixtures and Military Stars
summary.text: Astrological judgments for stars by planetary mixtures, including effects on rulers, soldiers, builders, religious actions, criminals, and acquisitions, followed by entries for Leo’s heart, Arcturus, the bright star of the Eagle, Antares, and Sirius with zodiacal positions, magnitudes, and Mars–Jupiter influences. Stars rising or culminating in the same degree are said to produce glorious, commanding generals who subject nations.
